rules.one_source: This is the editorial and pricing source of truth. Page-specific hardcoded pricing must be migrated and checked against these records.
rules.public_pricing: Only offers with status existing_public have already-listed price figures. Verify final scope/terms before migrating page copy.
rules.new_offers: Proposed offers must show 'Request a scope' or 'Custom quote', not invented dollar figures.
rules.hosting: Client retains control of domain and business accounts. Platform fees, support coverage, backups, change requests, and incident SLAs must be spelled out in each signed scope.
rules.data: Report reviews require customer-supplied existing reports or authorized data access. No invented financial savings or guaranteed outcomes.
rules.email: Newsletter signup needs separate subscriber storage, affirmative consent, unsubscribe, and actual send pipeline. Never send subscribers to the sales-lead endpoint.
rules.protected: Do not change api/lead.js or any lead-backend locked components without explicit UNLOCK LEAD BACKEND instruction.
